source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Βάσσα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It names its witness plainly — «Η μνήμη της Αγίας Βάσσας αναφέρεται στο Ιεροσολυμιτικό Κανονάριο (σελ. 120)» — which is a single source cited, not the site's own mark of doubt; there is no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The corpus keeps a `bassa-of-edessa`, kept on 21 August in all four calendars, and a `bassa-of-tyre` on the Greek 21 September; this one is a patrician and abbess at Jerusalem, a separate entry on the same calendar and therefore a separate commemoration, and nothing on any of the three pages joins them. The Stephen the page names is the bishop of Jamnia who was abbot of the house she founded, not a companion, and the corpus holds no folder this reading could attach to him, so no `related` row is made. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed.
